name: When should I consider a custom floor plan instead of a standard design?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a custom floor plan instead of a standard design?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a custom floor plan if standard designs don't fully meet your unique lifestyle, specific accessibility needs, or desire for specialized features. If you have a particular vision for how your space should function, require specific room dimensions, or want to integrate non-traditional elements, a custom plan is beneficial. It's also ideal if you need to optimize space for a specific purpose, such as a home office, a unique hobby area, or to accommodate particular furniture pieces not fitting standard layouts. Custom plans ensure your tiny home is truly yours.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a custom floor plan if standard designs don't meet your unique lifestyle, accessibility needs, or desire for specialized features and specific space optimization.
